justification: Inspected [src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/ParseErrorList.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/jhy/jsoup/src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/ParseErrorList.java), [src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/Parser.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/jhy/jsoup/src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/Parser.java), and [src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/TreeBuilder.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/jhy/jsoup/src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/TreeBuilder.java). ParseErrorList is only 50 lines and declares 5 small methods: 2 package-private constructors, 2 static factories, canAddError(), getMaxSize(), and clone(); it just extends ArrayList with initial/max capacity fields. Parser uses it only as a parse-error buffer via setTrackErrors()/getErrors(), and TreeBuilder only checks canAddError() before adding ParseError instances. This is a thin container with one responsibility, not an under-decomposed multi-responsibility class.
